content.value: An FIR digital filter has impulse response, h(n), defined over the interval $0 \leq n \leq N - 1$ . Show (10) that if $N = 7$ and h(n) satisfies symmetry condition $\mathbf { h } ( \dot { n } ) = \dot { n } ( N - n - 1 )$ the filter has a linear phase characteristics.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
